prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop landing-page composition option 3, 16:9 landscape
Primary request: Render a complete first viewport and the start of the next section for the real Clinimed Odontologia website, edge to edge, crisp readable Portuguese, no browser frame. It must unmistakably offer multidisciplinary dental care in Votuporanga and a working WhatsApp evaluation action.
Input images: Image 1 is the official Clinimed logo and must remain recognizable. Image 2 contributes authentic clinic material and daylight only; omit all old PLUG lettering and blue/yellow brand elements.
Committed world: Pavilhão Clinimed — luminous off-white, deep Clinimed green, one lime light band, translucent green glass, pale wood, abundant daylight, bold rounded humane sans. This option must go further than a standard hero while remaining a functional website.
Composition option 3: view the pavilion from beneath a vast diagonal translucent-glass canopy that enters at the upper left and sweeps to the lower right, acting as both a light source and the page’s reading path. The floating glass-bubble navigation sits within the canopy. Set the large headline across the architectural horizon, overlapping calm light and a wide clinic panorama without becoming a separate column. Embed three treatment portals directly into the lower edge of the canopy, then let the WhatsApp action terminate the lime light band near the lower right. Reveal the next section underneath the lifted canopy.
Text: menu “Início · Quem Somos · Tratamentos · Profissionais · Depoimentos · Blog · Contatos” and “Agende sua avaliação”. Headline “Cuidado que acompanha cada fase do seu sorriso.” Supporting line “Mais de 40 procedimentos. Uma equipe. Um plano feito para você.” Portals “Prevenção”, “Reabilitação”, “Estética”. Action “Agendar pelo WhatsApp”. Proof “Desde 2010 · Votuporanga/SP”. Next heading “Tudo começa com uma boa avaliação”.
Constraints: one dominant diagonal canopy, calm readable content, no split hero, no equal generic cards, no fake awards, no prices, no extra logos, no watermark.
